recap.text: Carl, his train bomb built, spots one of Eva's two sabers in the gore, dropped when Donut raised Hekla from the dead. He pulls it into his inventory and jumps out the front window of the vermillion engine. Its description says the pair is magical only together, so alone it gives no buffs. Good, thinks Carl: Eva has lost her main weapon.

Katia leaves the others with a large party of helpers: Louis and Firas, Gwen and her team, Daniel Bautista and a few of his friends, and Florin. Donut is about to cry, and Carl wants to argue but does not. He takes the Left Fang, half of Eva's main weapon, from his inventory and tells Katia to return it to its rightful owner. The saber glints green and venomous, and Katia nods and stows it in her inventory.

Katia and Li Na pull dead bugs off the unconscious Eva, who has ten seconds before she wakes. Li Na casts Preserve Injury so Eva cannot heal and points at the ring on her top right hand, the one that would let her disappear. Katia cuts that hand off with Eva's old sword, then the poisonous rapier from the top left stub. Eva wakes, spits defiance, begs, and Katia punches the sword through her breastplate into her chest.

beats.headline: Found in the gore
beats.text: His train bomb built, Carl is about to jump out of the front window of the vermillion engine when he spots something on the floor. It is one of Eva's two sabers, dropped when Donut raised Hekla from the dead, fallen into the gore and forgotten. He pulls it into his inventory and goes out the window. In the hours of grinding that follow, Katia practises with it in her smaller form. The description says it is part of a set, only magical when the two are together; alone, the enchanted saber gives no buffs at all. Good, thinks Carl. Eva has lost her main weapon.
beats.gist: Carl finds one of Eva's sabers in the gore and pockets it; alone, it gives no buffs.

beats.headline: Back to its rightful owner
beats.text: Katia is going to separate from them, with a pretty big party of helpers, Louis and Firas, Gwen and her team, Daniel Bautista and a few of his friends, and Florin, and Donut is about to cry. Carl wants to argue, and does not. He pulls the Left Fang from his inventory, half of Eva's main weapon, and tells Katia to make sure she returns it to its rightful owner. The saber glints with a green, venomous light. Katia nods, and it disappears into her inventory. She will make sure of it.
beats.gist: Katia leaves with a large party, and Carl gives her the Left Fang to return to its owner.

beats.headline: Through the breastplate
beats.text: Katia and Li Na pull dead bugs off the unconscious Eva, who has almost no health and ten seconds before she wakes. Li Na casts Preserve Injury so she cannot heal, and points at the ring on Eva's top right hand, the one that would let her disappear. Katia draws Eva's old sword and cuts the hand off with it, then the poisonous rapier from the top left stub. Eva wakes, spits defiance, then begs. Katia plunges the sword into her chest, punching right through the metal of her magical breastplate. Die, Eva.
beats.gist: Katia and Li Na stop Eva healing, cut off her ring hand and rapier, and Katia stabs her.

relations.note: one of her pair, dropped on the train
